title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 44
paragraphs: At this time the Sybarites say that they and their king Telys were about to make an expedition against Croton, and the Crotoniats, being exceedingly alarmed, asked Dorieus to help them and obtained their request. So Dorieus joined them in an expedition against Sybaris and helped them take the city. This is what the Sybarites say of the doings of Dorieus and his followers; but the Crotoniats say that no stranger helped them in the war against the Sybarites, except Callias alone, a diviner of Elis and one of the descendants of Iamus, and he in the following way: he ran away, they say, from Telys the tyrant of the Sybarites, when the sacrifices did not prove favorable as he was sacrificing for the expedition against Croton, and so came to them.
